tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Put a file online and get a short public link. Pass text directly, or base64 with encoding="base64" for binary files (images, PDFs, zips). An .html file becomes a web page; a .zip containing index.html becomes a website. Returns the URL and expires_at; anonymous callers also get a manage_token. Stat

tools.name: create_upload_session
tools.description: For files too large to send inline: reserves a link and returns a one-time upload_url. PUT the raw bytes there (e.g. give the user the returned curl command), then poll get_link with the slug (and manage_token) until status is "live".

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Put a web page or small static site you created online instantly. Pass {"files": {"index.html": "<!doctype html>…", "style.css": "…", "app.js": "…"}} (paths relative to the site root; index.html required). Images can go in base64_files. Returns the public URL. Pages are served sandboxed on their own

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Status of a link: live, checking, publishing, unpublished, in_review, removed (by moderation: removed_reason + appeal_url), expired or awaiting_upload; plus expiry, size and views (null when the account’s plan has no view counts). Anonymous callers pass the manage_token they got on creation.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the links in the connected Put It Online account (newest first, permanent first). Requires a connected account.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Permanently delete a link and its files. Account owners can delete their links; anonymous callers need the manage_token. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: set_password
tools.description: Protect a link with a password (visitors must enter it), or pass null to remove it. Requires a connected account whose plan includes passwords; otherwise returns a subscription_required error.

tools.name: make_permanent
tools.description: Turn an expiring link into a permanent one (uses one of the plan's permanent slots; see get_account). Requires a connected account whose plan includes permanent links.

tools.name: extend
tools.description: Restart an expiring link's expiry clock (also brings back a recently expired link). Permanent links are unaffected. Requires a connected account whose plan includes extending.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The connected account's plan, permanent-link slots used/available, size limit and features.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "set_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_file · Private data: upload_file, create_upload_session, publish_site, delete_link, set_password · Public sink: upload_file, create_upload_session, publish_site · Destructive: delete_link, set_password.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_file · Private data: upload_file, create_upload_session, publish_site, delete_link, set_password · Public sink: upload_file, create_upload_session, publish_site · Destructive: delete_link, set_password

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
